name: hafez-development-system
description: A skills-first project operating system that inspects, resumes, builds, verifies, and hands off software work.

interface.shortDescription: Take a project from its current state to a verified milestone.
interface.longDescription: Use natural language to start a new project or safely understand and continue an existing codebase. Hafez routes work through focused skills for inspection, durable state, vertical slices, architecture, verification, delegation, and handoff.
defaultPrompt: Use Hafez Autopilot to take over this project, safely adopt it if needed, and continue through implementation, delegation, review, debugging, integration, and verification until the next verified milestone. Use helper models for bounded work and ask me only at a genuine product, architecture, authority, or destructive decision boundary.
Resume the active Hafez Autopilot loop. Do not stop for recoverable test, worker, provider, or integration failures; repair, retry, fail over, or escalate automatically.
Deliver the next vertical slice using the strongest model as lead reviewer/integrator and helper models for safe bounded work.
